description: Narrative beats for generating a deck from a short brief. The outline model follows the order, merges beats the brief does not support and never invents facts to fill a beat. Labels are guidance for the model, not slide titles.

feature.label: Фича
beats: problem: what users struggle with today and why it matters
users: who is affected and in which scenario
solution: what the feature does, in one idea
how_it_works: user flow or main steps
value: what changes for users and the business
scope: what is in and out of the first release
success_metrics: how the result will be measured
risks: main risks and how they are handled

product.label: Продукт
beats: market_problem: the customer problem and its cost
audience: target segments and their needs
product: what the product is and its core promise
differentiation: why it is better than current alternatives
business_model: how it creates revenue or savings

project.label: Проект
beats: approach: how the work is organised
status_or_results: current status or expected results

initiative.label: Инициатива
beats: problem: what is not working now
alternatives: options considered and why this one
implementation: how it would be introduced
